_comment: Weather and the dark, per biome (WRSurvival; cooks/build-survival.md, survival-crafting 2.4, world-map 2.6). Each biome rolls every rollMinutes: one weather at a time, by chance (dayOnly / nightOnly respected), announced warnSeconds ahead (the toast, the fog closing in from the horizon, the bed rising), ramping in over rampSeconds and out over fadeSeconds. effects reach a player only outdoors (a roof within counters.roofWithin cm, a cave) and not countered (resist = infused armour frost / lava, armor ids, pathNodes path.node, items carried). No temperature meter: every effect is a gear check or a change in what you can see (DD Ruled out). look: fx / baseFx thicken the falling weather at the camera, fogDensity and fogColor (sRGB) the haze, skyDim the sun, glyph the HUD's Data/UI/Glyphs icon. darkNights: unlit at night outside a light; underground: unlit anywhere outside a light; corruption.path: the path that gains instead of suffering. Only volcanic and tundra exist on the island today; the other rows switch on when their land does.

kinds.name: Ashfall
kinds.does: Ash chokes the air: about 60 m to see, thirst x1.25 in the open, outdoor crops stop growing. A roof, or Forgeplate, keeps it off.

kinds.name: Overcast
kinds.does: Grey skies: dimmer light.

kinds.name: Rain
kinds.does: Rain: torches burn faster; a roof keeps it off.

kinds.name: Blizzard
kinds.does: Whiteout: about 40 m to see, deep snow slows your run, stamina returns slower in the open, Gloomhowls hunt from further. A roof or frost gear holds it off.

kinds.name: Snowfall
kinds.does: Heavy snow: about 200 m to see.

kinds.name: Freezing fog
kinds.does: Freezing fog: you can see about 70 m; creatures notice you later.

kinds.does: Grey skies: dimmer light.

kinds.name: Thunderstorm
kinds.does: Lightning seeks the highest body above 600 m: a glow under your feet, then the bolt a second later; gusts shove you on the heights. Get low, get under rock, or carry a grounding charm.

kinds.does: The halls breathe spores: their clouds spread half again as wide. A filter mask or Sporeweave keeps them out.

kinds.does: Corruption builds twice as fast in the open. Stay by a brazier or under a roof; Gravecloth or Hollowplate holds it off.
